name: salvor-example-langchain
description: A support desk built with LangChain's createAgent, made durable by the salvor middleware.

comments.@salvor-run/client: This checkout's SDK, by relative path, because the LangChain entry point is not on npm yet. Once it ships, this becomes an ordinary version range and nothing else here changes.
comments.install: run.sh installs with `npm install --install-links --omit=optional`: --install-links copies the SDK in rather than symlinking it, so its `langchain` import resolves to the one copy installed here, and --omit=optional keeps the key-free path from pulling a provider it will not use.
comments.@langchain/anthropic: Optional, and only for the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY path. `npm install --install-links` (without --omit=optional) fetches it.
